description: This file implements a lockfile utility for managing file locks, including acquiring, releasing, and updating locks with handling for stale locks and process exit cleanup.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires a lock on a specified file, with options for retries and stale lock handling.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired lock on a file.

methods.name: ensureCleanup
methods.description: Sets up cleanup of locks on process exit.
